open ThesisCommon
variable (𝕜 Γ E X : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]

  intro hΓ hs hnot hsep T

  exact UncountableSchauderSum.diagonal_coordinates_of_separable hs hnot hΓ T

end PFP
